annotations.title: Write a native draft for each platform

description: Writes one draft per platform from a single idea, adapted to each network's rules (character limit, hashtags, title and tags for YouTube, hook-first caption for TikTok and Reels, link placement for LinkedIn). Nothing is published. Returns { drafts: { <platform>: { text, title?, tags? } } } and, if the writer skipped a platform, { missing: [...] }. Counts toward the account's daily AI limit.

brand_voice.description: Optional tone or style notes, e.g. "friendly, no emojis, first person plural".

media_url.description: Optional public https URL of the photo or video the post is about.

prompt.description: The idea or message to communicate. More detail gives better drafts.
